references.text: Abraham became wealthy because of Pharaoh's gifts on account of Sarai
The Lord has blessed Abraham in all things, and he has become very rich
Isaac became wealthy and continued to grow richer until he was very rich
Jacob became very rich with large flocks, male and female servants, camels, and donkeys
He who fears the Lord and takes great delight in his commandments, his descendants will be mighty on earth; wealth and riches are in his house
